title: XR - VRS in right eye is offset, only on AMD
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in v4.6.beta2.mono.official [551ce8d47] ### System information Godot v4.6.beta2.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.22029.9039) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory ### Issue description When using VRS in XR, the right eye's VRS seems to be offset, making things near the center of the view less clear. I lowered my Render resolution in SteamVR in order to make the effect more easily visible. I had a friend with an NVIDIA GPU run a build of a project I'm working on where this occurs, and they couldn't replicate it. I'm wondering if this is somehow an issue specific to AMD graphics cards. ### Steps to reproduce If you're using SteamVR to test this, It's easier to see if you lower your render resolution first before running. - Run the attached MRP with a VR headset - Notice around the edges of the left eye are less detailed - Notice the right eye has less detail near the center, it feels like the VRS texture is offset on the right eye ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [vrs-issue-repro_2026-01-02_16-58-05.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24412750/vrs-issue-repro_2026-01-02_16-58-05.zip)
